title: Pro-Router: Token-Aware Progressive Model Routing with Adaptive Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.28726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The remarkable performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) comes at the cost of substantial computational overhead, posing significant challenges to real-time deployment and cost effectiveness. Existing model routing approaches either decide from coarse request-level features alone or spend one or several extra language model passes to inspect the generated response, leaving the token-level uncertainty signals that emerge during generation unused. To address these limitations, we propose Pro-Router, a token-aware progressive model routing method with adaptive edge-cloud collaboration for efficient multimodal LLM inference. Pro-Router employs a two-stage progressive decision mechanism. First, a lightweight prompt pre-scorer module performs rapid pre-screening before token generation begins, guiding apparently simple requests to small models. translated_title: Pro-Router：面向高效多模态大语言模型推理的令牌感知渐进式模型路由与自适应端云协同
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的卓越性能以巨大的计算开销为代价，给实时部署和成本效益带来了重大挑战。现有的模型路由方法要么仅依据粗粒度的请求级特征进行决策，要么需要额外进行一次或多次语言模型推理来检查生成的响应，因而未能利用生成过程中涌现的令牌级不确定性信号。为解决这些局限，我们提出Pro-Router，一种令牌感知的渐进式模型路由方法，通过自适应端云协同实现高效的多模态LLM推理。Pro-Router采用两阶段渐进式决策机制：首先，轻量级的提示预评分模块在令牌生成开始之前进行快速预筛选，将明显简单的请求引导至小模型；其次，令牌感知验证器读取每个令牌的采样概率分布（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Pro-Router提出一种令牌感知的两阶段渐进式路由方法，结合自适应端云协同，利用生成过程中的令牌级不确定性信号动态分配请求至端侧小模型或云端大模型，从而在保证推理质量的同时显著降低多模态大语言模型的计算开销。
en_tdlr: Pro-Router is a token-aware progressive routing framework with adaptive edge-cloud collaboration that exploits token-level uncertainty signals during generation to efficiently route multimodal LLM requests between small and large models, reducing computational overhead while maintaining performance.
